recent: Well Chip 于2026年11月17日完成1股配5股、每股RM1.00的可放弃配股，共发行1.2亿股新股，超额认购23.33%。同期多名董事（包括CEO Ng Hooi Lang和董事Tang Soo Yen）在公开市场出售所持配股权。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收同比增8.7%，但环比降5.8%，净利环比降14.2%。

recent_en: Well Chip completed its 1-for-5 renounceable rights issue at RM1.00 per share on 17 November 2026, issuing 120 million new shares with a 23.33% oversubscription. During the same period, several directors, including CEO Ng Hooi Lang and Director Tang Soo Yen, disposed of their rights entitlements in the open market. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 8.7% year-on-year but fell 5.8% quarter-on-quarter, while net profit declined 14.2% quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: Completed a 1-for-5 renounceable rights issue at RM1.00 per share, issuing 120 million new shares with a 23.33% oversubscription.
The rights shares were listed and quoted on the Main Market of Bursa Securities on 17 November 2026.
Shareholders approved the rights issue of up to RM120 million at the general meeting on 3 September 2026.
risks_en: Executive Director and CEO Ng Hooi Lang disposed of rights entitlements multiple times between 19 and 23 October 2026.
Executive Director Tang Soo Yen disposed of rights entitlements on 19 October 2026.
The rights issue of 120 million new shares represents approximately 16.7% of the enlarged share capital, diluting existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM71.61 million, up 8.7% year-on-year but down 5.8% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM23.93 million, up 17.9% year-on-year but down 14.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 33.4%, lower than 36.7% in the previous quarter.
